app.title: Teardown Mod Maker
app.tagline: Snap blocks together to make your own Teardown mod
app.tutorial_note: A quick video on making your first mod. You can open it again with the Tutorial button.
app.help_hint: Hold T to see what things mean
app.help_title: Help mode: let go of T to close
app.code_note: The blocks write this code for you. Teardown reads it to run your mod.
app.confirm_new: Start a new mod? Your blocks will be cleared.
app.open_failed: That file couldn't be opened. Pick a file you saved from this app.
app.confirm_open: Open this file? It replaces the blocks you have now, so save first if you want to keep them.
app.blocks_skipped: Some blocks come from a different version of the editor and couldn't be opened, so they were left out: %1.
app.confirm_lang_lose: Your browser isn't letting this page save, so switching language will clear your blocks. Save your mod first. Switch anyway?
app.load_failed: The editor couldn't load. Check your internet connection and reload the page. (It needs unpkg.com.)
app.author: Your name
app.vox_hint: Made in MagicaVoxel. Leave empty to use a simple stick.
app.install_steps: 1. Unzip the file. 2. Put the folder in Documents\Teardown\mods. 3. In Teardown, open Mod Manager, turn your mod on, then play Sandbox.

errors.empty_mod: Nothing in your mod will run yet. Put your blocks inside an event block, like "when key is pressed".
errors.too_big: Your mod is too big. Try removing some blocks.
errors.vox_too_big: That .vox file is too big (2 MB max).
errors.not_vox: That doesn't look like a .vox file.
errors.zip_failed: Couldn't make the zip. Try again, or reload the page.
errors.code_failed: Some blocks couldn't be turned into code. Try removing the last block you added.
errors.no_shoot_vox: A shoot block uses "my own model". Pick a .vox file to shoot first.

app.lua_hint: Type Lua for Teardown. Your variables, My blocks and Teardown's functions all work here.
app.shoot_vox_hint: Used by shoot blocks set to "my own model".
app.examples_hint: Open one to try it in Teardown, see how it works, and change it. More stars means it does more.
app.examples_confirm: Open this example? It replaces the blocks you have now, so save first if you want to keep them.

mod.name: Mod
mod.desc: A change or add-on for a game. Your mod adds new things to Teardown.

lua.name: Lua
lua.desc: The programming language Teardown mods are written in. The blocks write it for you.

vox.name: .vox file
vox.desc: A 3D model made of little cubes (voxels). You can make one in MagicaVoxel.

frame.name: Frame
frame.desc: The game redraws the screen about 60 times a second. Each redraw is one frame.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Something that happens, like pressing a key. Blocks inside an event run when it happens.

events.name: Events
events.desc: Blocks that start things. Every other block must go inside one of these.

actions.name: Actions
actions.desc: Blocks that make something happen in the game, like an explosion.

player.name: Player
player.desc: Blocks that change you: your health, where you are and how you move.

places.name: Places
places.desc: Blocks that pick a spot in the world, like where you're looking.

logic.name: If / Then
logic.desc: Only do something when a question is true, like 'is my health below 50?'.

loops.name: Repeat
loops.desc: Do the same blocks several times in a row.

math.name: Numbers
math.desc: Numbers and maths, like adding or picking a random number.

text.name: Text
text.desc: Words and letters, like a message to show on screen.

variables.name: Variable
variables.desc: A named box that remembers a value, like a score.

when_start.name: When the game starts
when_start.desc: Runs once, when the level loads.

every_frame.name: Every frame
every_frame.desc: Runs all the time, 60 times a second. Careful: explosions here happen non-stop!

when_key.name: When key is pressed
when_key.desc: Runs once each time you press that key in the game.

tool.name: Tool
tool.desc: Something you hold and use in Teardown, like the sledgehammer. Click to use it in game.

tool_auto.name: Automatic tool
tool_auto.desc: A tool that keeps going while you hold the left mouse button: once straight away, then every few seconds. Great for machine guns and lasers.

explode.name: Explosion
explode.desc: Blows things up. Size goes from 0.5 (small pop) to 4 (huge boom).

hole.name: Make a hole
hole.desc: Removes blocks in a ball shape without a bang. Size goes up to 5.

fire.name: Fire
fire.desc: Sets the spot on fire. Wood burns, metal doesn't.

shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.desc: Fires a bullet, a rocket or a shotgun blast from where you're looking.

message.name: Show message
message.desc: Writes a short message on the screen for a few seconds. If your mod has a tool, you only see it while you hold the tool.

set_health.name: Health
set_health.desc: How alive you are. 100% is full, 0% means game over.

health.name: My health
health.desc: Your health right now, from 0 to 100.

launch.name: Launch
launch.desc: Throws you up into the air. Bigger power means higher.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Moves you to a place instantly.

slowmo.name: Slow motion
slowmo.desc: Makes the whole game slow down for a few seconds.

regen.name: Healing by itself
regen.desc: Teardown slowly fills your health back up. Turn it off when the game starts, so damage from your mod stays.

look_point.name: Where I'm looking
look_point.desc: The spot in the middle of your screen, up to 100 metres away.

my_pos.name: My position
my_pos.desc: The spot where you are standing.

in_front.name: In front of me
in_front.desc: A spot some metres in front of you. It stops just before a wall or the floor.

if.name: If
if.desc: Checks a question. The blocks inside only run if the answer is true.

compare.name: Compare
compare.desc: Asks if two numbers are equal, bigger or smaller.

and_or.name: And / Or
and_or.desc: Joins two questions. 'And' needs both true, 'or' needs one.

true_false.name: True / False
true_false.desc: Yes or no. The answer to a question.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.desc: Runs the blocks inside this many times, up to 100.

arithmetic.name: Maths
arithmetic.desc: Adds, takes away, multiplies or divides two numbers.

random.name: Random number
random.desc: Picks a surprise number between two numbers.

variable_set.name: Set variable
variable_set.desc: Puts a value in a variable so you can use it later.

variable_get.name: Variable
variable_get.desc: Gets the value stored in a variable.

new.name: New
new.desc: Clears the blocks so you can start a new mod.

open.name: Open
open.desc: Loads a mod you saved before.

save.name: Save
save.desc: Saves your blocks to a file so you can keep working later.

show_code.name: Show code
show_code.desc: Shows the Lua code your blocks make. This is what real modders write.

download.name: Download mod
download.desc: Makes a zip file you can put in Teardown's mods folder.

tutorial.name: Tutorial
tutorial.desc: Plays a short video that shows how to make a mod.

other_work.name: My other work
other_work.desc: Links to other websites made by the person who made this app.

discord.name: Discord
discord.desc: Our Discord server. Tell us about bugs or suggest new blocks and features.

workspace.name: Workspace
workspace.desc: Drag blocks here and snap them together. Drag a block to the bin to delete it.

every_seconds.name: Every few seconds
every_seconds.desc: Runs again and again, waiting this many seconds in between.

paint.name: Paint
paint.desc: Colours walls and objects. Yellow spray or black scorch marks. Size goes up to 5.

shake.name: Screen shake
shake.desc: Wobbles your view, like after a big bang.

sound.name: Play sound
sound.desc: Plays one of the game's own sounds where you are.

change_health.name: Change health
change_health.desc: Adds to your health, or takes some away if the number is below zero.

push_me.name: Push me
push_me.desc: Gives you a shove in a direction. Bigger power means faster.

speed.name: My speed
speed.desc: How fast you're moving, in metres per second.

key_held.name: Key held down
key_held.desc: True for as long as you keep holding the key.

on_ground.name: On the ground
on_ground.desc: True when your feet are on the floor, false when you're in the air.

above.name: Above
above.desc: A spot higher up than another spot.

random_near.name: Random spot
random_near.desc: A surprise spot somewhere around another spot.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.desc: Harder blocks for bigger ideas. Open it to see more groups.

timers.name: Timers
timers.desc: Blocks that wait or count time.

after.name: After seconds
after.desc: Waits, then runs the blocks inside. Everything else keeps going while it waits. Places inside are checked when the wait ends, so to use the spot you look at now, save it in a variable first.

time.name: Time
time.desc: How many seconds have passed since the level started.

screen.name: Screen
screen.desc: Blocks that put big words on the screen or change its colours.

screen_text.name: Screen text
screen_text.desc: Shows big words on the screen. If your mod has a tool, they only show while you hold it. If not, they fade a few seconds after they last changed.

clear_screen.name: Clear screen text
clear_screen.desc: Removes all the big words your mod put on the screen.

filter.name: Screen colours
filter.desc: Changes how the whole game looks, like an old photo.

objects.name: Objects
objects.desc: Blocks that move, make or remove things in the world.

push_thing.name: Push it
push_thing.desc: Shoves the object you're looking at. Walls and floors don't move.

delete_thing.name: Make it disappear
delete_thing.desc: Removes the object you're looking at. Only works on things that can move.

spawn_box.name: Spawn a box
spawn_box.desc: Makes a new box that falls and breaks like real objects. Size goes from 0.1 to 5 metres.

looking_at_thing.name: Looking at something
looking_at_thing.desc: True when the middle of your screen points at an object that can move.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.desc: What pulls everything down. Change it to float like on the moon!

light.name: Light
light.desc: Adds a glowing light that stays until you turn your lights off. Up to 50 at once: a new one replaces the oldest.

lights_off.name: Lights off
lights_off.desc: Turns off every light your mod added.

particles.name: Smoke and sparks
particles.desc: A puff of smoke or a burst of sparks.

rain.name: Rain
rain.desc: Makes it rain, or stops the rain.

my_blocks.name: My blocks
my_blocks.desc: Make your own block from other blocks, then use it again and again.

function_def.name: My block
function_def.desc: Your own block. Put blocks inside, then use it from the My blocks group.

function_call.name: Use my block
function_call.desc: Runs the blocks inside your own block.

function_return.name: Return
function_return.desc: Stops your block early and gives back a value.

not.name: Not
not.desc: Flips true to false, and false to true.

join.name: Join text
join.desc: Sticks text together, like 'Score: ' and a number.

variable_change.name: Change variable
variable_change.desc: Adds a number to a variable, like adding 1 to a score.

while_every.name: While … every
while_every.desc: Runs the blocks inside every few seconds, but only while the yes/no block is true. Great with "key held down".

shoot_object.name: Shoot a thing
shoot_object.desc: Fires a ball, crate, barrel, brick or wrecking ball from in front of you. "My own model" shoots a .vox file you pick when you download the mod.

laser.name: Laser
laser.desc: A beam from your hand to where you look. It burns a small hole. Put it in "while … every" with a short time to keep firing.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.desc: A bolt from the sky with a flash and a small explosion.

power.name: Powers
power.desc: God mode: you can't get hurt. Fly mode: you can fly. Super jump and super speed: jump higher and run faster.

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.desc: Zooms your view in, like a scope. ×1 is normal.

in_car.name: In a car
in_car.desc: Yes while you're driving a car or another vehicle.

boost_car.name: Boost my car
boost_car.desc: Pushes the car you're driving forward or up. Does nothing when you're on foot.

last_shot.name: My last shot
last_shot.desc: Where the last thing you shot is now. If it's gone, it's where you're looking.

force.name: Black hole or blast wave
force.desc: Pulls or pushes everything that can move near a place.

throw_held.name: Throw
throw_held.desc: Throws the thing you're holding where you look. Pick something up with the game's grab key first.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.desc: A frozen object stops and hangs in the air. Unfreeze it to let it fall again.

weather.name: Weather
weather.desc: Changes the sky and light: day, sunset, night, fog or snow. Day puts the game's normal look back.

lua_code.name: Lua code
lua_code.desc: Real Lua, the language Teardown mods are written in. Click the code to change it. A warning sign means there's a mistake.

lua_value.name: Lua value
lua_value.desc: A bit of Lua that gives back a value, like GetTime() or 2 * 3.

lua_top.name: Lua at the top
lua_top.desc: Lua that goes at the top of main.lua, for your own functions and variables.

code.name: Code
code.desc: Blocks where you type real Lua code.

examples.name: Examples
examples.desc: Ready-made mods, from a simple gun to a small game. Open one to see how it works, then change it.

pop_gun.name: Pop Gun
pop_gun.desc: The simplest gun: click to fire a bullet with a bang. One tool and three blocks. Start here!
pop_gun.mod_desc: A simple gun that fires bullets with a bang.

rocket_launcher.name: Rocket Launcher
rocket_launcher.desc: Fires 4 rockets, then press R to reload. Teaches variables, if / else and a timer.
rocket_launcher.mod_desc: A rocket launcher with 4 rockets. Press R to reload when it's empty.
rocket_launcher.empty: Out of rockets! Press R to reload.

crate_cannon.name: Crate Cannon
crate_cannon.desc: Shoots crates, barrels or wrecking balls. Q picks what it shoots, B blows up your last shot. Teaches else if and your first My block.
crate_cannon.mod_desc: Shoots crates, barrels or wrecking balls. Q changes the ammo, B blows up your last shot.
crate_cannon.ammo_balls: Ammo: wrecking balls  [Q] change  [B] blow up

superhero.name: Superhero Kit
superhero.desc: Hold H for a nonstop heat-vision laser. Also flying, a blast wave, freezing and zoom, and you can't get hurt and jump super high. Teaches "while … every" and on/off switches made with variables.
superhero.mod_desc: Hold H for a heat-vision laser. G fly, V blast wave, C freeze, X unfreeze, Z zoom, Q shows the keys. You can't get hurt and you jump super high.
superhero.keys_text: [H] laser  [G] fly  [V] blast  [C] freeze  [X] unfreeze  [Z] zoom
superhero.keys_again: Press Q to see the keys again.

storm_survival.name: Storm Survival
storm_survival.desc: A minigame: press N, then survive 60 seconds of lightning that keeps getting worse. Teaches a countdown, repeat, My blocks and real Lua code.
storm_survival.mod_desc: Press N, then survive 60 seconds of lightning that keeps getting worse.
storm_survival.press_n: Press N to start the storm!
storm_survival.lua_top:
-- Real Lua: picks a title from how much health you have left.
-- GetPlayerHealth() gives 0 to 1 (1 is full health), not 0 to 100 like the "my health" block.
function storm_title()
  local health = GetPlayerHealth()
  if health > 0.8 then return "Not a scratch!" end
  if health > 0.4 then return "Still standing!" end
  return "That was close!"
end
